justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr/Value/BinOp/UnaryOp/EvalError, but error messages are still String-typed inside variants rather than structured (e.g., TypeError(String) instead of carrying operator/expected/actual types).
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with the three required variants and no panics in library code, but TypeError carries a stringly-typed message rather than structured context, and ParseError likewise uses a String message field.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean surface with Display/Debug, doc comments on most public items, and sensible derives, though ParseError lacks an Error trait impl and some public items (BinOp/UnaryOp variants, EvalError variants) have minimal documentation.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and derive usage, but the env is a Vec scanned with a manual reverse loop instead of using rposition/iter chains, and Debug is hand-written for errors instead of derived.
